findings.message: Forms approveExpense and rejectExpense (organism approvalDecision) had no <command>.input state. Added approveExpenseInput and rejectExpenseInput drafts (DecisionDraft, every leaf nullable) with setApproveExpenseInput and setRejectExpenseInput. id, colaboradorId and version are filled from the selected expense at submit when the draft leaves them null.

despesaSelecionada (select:expenseReview) had no function that writes it, and no query fetches a single expense. Added selectExpenseReview(id|null), the getter expenseReview (row of despesasDaEquipe by id) and expenseReviewColaborador (collaborator of that row).

loadMorePendingTeamExpenses needs the page size and hasMore returned by the list routes, but no state holds them. Added pageSizePendingTeamExpenses and hasMorePendingTeamExpenses; the page state is kept in sync with the output.

approveExpense and rejectExpense return only a partial record (id, version, details.motivoRejeicao), with no status, and the defs declare no mode for despesasDaEquipe or despesaSelecionada. Applied: the decided expense is removed from despesasDaEquipe and the selection is cleared. The colaborador list is left untouched.
